lens: Skyhook: finance, program and canon tools
title: The Null Input
tagline: What a fiber quote would do to the case: a Python sweep that adds the fiber purchase line the model does not have, per tier, and prints a quote-day card so the Toyobo reply can be read in one line.
pitch: rev_a.json carries economics.fiber_cost_per_kg: null, flagged WEAKEST INPUT, and DECISION_LOG item 8 notes the finance model prices fiber launch, not fiber purchase, so a quote adds capex nobody has counted. fiber_sweep.py reads the ladder and rev_a tiers, re-derives the conservative/baseline/optimistic cash flows (gated at price 0 to the published triples), then sweeps fiber purchase price from $0 to $3,000/kg (log) with an optional finished-tether multiplier for weaving and jackets (default 1.0, labelled unsourced). For each tier and column it prints added capex, new payback year, NPV@10% and the Y15 breakeven customer price, and shows how the six minimal-relaxation thresholds move (the construction-launch threshold of $1,674/kg falls as fiber price rises; the price at which each baseline-substitution single stops closing). Two markers are drawn and never used as defaults: MP-001's Zylon marketplace proxy ($300/$259/$170 per kg, 'marketplace listing — low confidence, not a Toyobo quote') and inspace_fork.py's $1,000 placeholder. The --quote P flag prints the quote-day card: 'at $P/kg of fiber, Conservative adds $X M capex (609.1 t), payback Y17 -> Yn; cislunar 2.8 adds $Y M (1,476.3 t); phase-3 adds $Z M (15,429.8 t); the rev_a key to fill is economics.fiber_cost_per_kg'. With no price set it refuses to print any fiber line.
whyNow: params/rev_a.json economics.fiber_cost_per_kg null with _fiber_cost_note 'WEAKEST INPUT — no vendor quote; obtain from Toyobo/Avient/Toray'; README.md open item 1 ('Fiber vendor quote — largest unpriced capex input'); docs/DECISION_LOG.md item 8 ('the financial model currently prices fiber launch, not fiber purchase, so a quote adds capex not yet in the model'); MORNING_REPORT.md anomaly 5; handoff.md 'Waiting ... Toyobo, FibrXL'.
computes: Inputs: ladder.json, rev_a.json materials/kinematics tiers, price p, multiplier m. Math: fiber mass per tier/column from EQ-6; purchase capex = p × m × fiber kg, added to total capex and spread 15/30/35/20 over Y1–4 like the rest; cash flow, payback, NPV@8/10/12, breakeven price as in finance/skyhook_finance.py; thresholds by bisection as in sensitivity.py, recomputed at each p; quote card formatting. Gate: p=0 must reproduce $8,741M/Y17/−$3,883M, $5,772M/Y9, $4,226M/Y7 or the script exits 2 before printing a sweep.
dataNeeded: ladder.json (1 KB, derived with sidecar from the workbook); rev_a.json --pick materials,kinematics,economics (3 KB); MP-001 proxy row cited to docs/research/mp001_market_pricing.md line 24 at 34935cb; example.txt of the sweep for the gallery.
existingOverlap: finance/inspace_fork.py has a fiber-price axis (SURFACE_FIBER_PRICE_PER_KG=1000, require_non_null guard, fiber_purchase_M rows) but for the DRAFT, non-canonical MXER in-space fork, not the Rev A suborbital program; finance/skyhook_finance.py has no purchase line; tools/sims/skyhook_no_leo_stress_test.jsx hardcodes fiberPriceKg 250 [Speculative]. This candidate puts the purchase line on the Rev A tiers, shows the threshold shifts, and gives the quote-day card.
honestyRisks: The marketplace proxy read as a price — it is a marker with its MP-001 wording, never a default. A quote may be per kg of yarn while the tether needs finished rope — the multiplier exists for that and is flagged unsourced at 1.0. Fiber mass is the canonical Zylon-only EQ-6 mass although the baseline is a hybrid — stated. Printing a fiber cost with no price set — refused, mirroring inspace_fork.require_non_null.
testPlan: test_fiber_sweep.py (stdlib): p=0 reproduces the three published triples and the $6,877M/Y14 variant; conservative added capex at p=300, m=1 equals 609.1304 × 300 × 1000 / 1e6 = $182.74M (hand check); payback and NPV are monotone in p; the launch threshold decreases with p and the cadence threshold increases; --quote without a number exits 2 with the null-input message; output is byte-identical across runs.
landing: Skyhook finance/fiber_price_sweep.py with FIBER_PRICE_FINDINGS.md. To ship: add a null-guarded purchase line to skyhook_finance.py and the workbook's Assumptions sheet, then replace the sweep with the actual quote and fill economics.fiber_cost_per_kg with its source.
